title: MZ Seraphim wings for TV/SV characters?

posts.author: LunarFlareStudios
posts.body:
Resource type: Character Parts (both TV and SV), but not specifically for generator. I prefer to put my characters together in Photoshop, since I use Holder’s bases to create humanoid characters. However, I’d still like the pieces to be compatible with the RTP, as I occasionally use the chibi sprites for some other projects.
Maker format: MZ
Makers I own: XP, VXAce, MV, MZ.
Art style: RTP if you can. I use edited RTP-style pieces on Holder’s sprites, and as I mentioned, I do use the RTP style occasionally.
Description: I have a character (my sona, actually) whose angelic form has six wings, like a Seraphim. I’m struggling to find a proper piece for that, however… most of what I find is either stolen assets from a game, not for public use, or has parts missing that I need. The rest is completely unrelated to my Google search. I go to the RPG Maker DLC store, and there’s nothing there either! What is a novice artist to do?
Truth be told, there really aren’t many Maker-friendly seraphim pieces online, so I’m struggling to create Minty’s true angelic form. Here’s the story behind this form.
Though Minty is originally a normal Magi, her status increases to High Demi-Angel after the Creator sees that, despite seeing her former bully Liam being led astray by demons, she does not want to see him cast into the Pit of Punishment. Instead, she wants to see him learn a better way, betray the demons he’s been tricked into serving, and give up on his desire to slay her. The Creator sees this as a clear pattern, as she has shown mercy, kindness, and love to each villain she meets, and they almost always end up reformed and redeemed because of this. Minty is, therefore, blessed with angelic abilities beyond any other Magi (except her boyfriend, but that’s a story of its own) and given the rank of High Priestess of Redemption. She was already fabled to be one of the two Magi in charge of saving the Multiverse during the Final Armageddon, so this rank also gave her the ability to traverse it freely, spreading friendship, hope, and justice to each corner of the Creator’s kingdom.
Though this rank is a whole new responsibility for her, she rarely takes this true form, instead appearing in her civilian form most of the time. She occasionally uses a pair of green holographic wings to fly in this form, but for the most part, she appears as a normal Magi out of humility. She does not like to take her true form unless she really needs to.
Since she has such a high rank, her main design is based around a Seraphim, the highest-ranking angel in Biblical hierarchy. I specifically designed her around the Seraphim seen in Hazbin Hotel, a series I take interest in on occasion. Here’s a screenshot in case you haven’t seen it. (It’s a really good show!)
But where are the proper wings to create our own mystical six-winged heroes? Am I the only one who’s asked for this? And furthermore, what if our heroes… are supposed to meet a Seraphim that gives them something, like a holy blade or an ancient prophecy?
I’d honestly love a pair of Seraphim wings in the RTP style, but I think they should be a little bigger than the ones that appear in the generator. If this needs to be a paid request, I’m willing to cough up the money for it, but I’m starting here first just in case. As I usually say, it’s a shot in the dark.
The idea is simple: six white feathered wings, three on each side, for both TV and SV sprites. I would prefer the wings to flap a little on the TV sprite, but it’s not needed for the SV sprite as I know that such a request is probably a lot to create. If you are able to make the SV flap, though, I’d like that. And I know Sera and Emily’s wings don’t flap in unison in Hazbin Hotel, but I think it would be easier to animate if the wings here did all flap at once (to fit the RMMZ format better). And if possible, can one variant have a simple eye in the middle of each wing? Minty's angel form has a lot of eyes, including five on her face and one on her chest, plus, as mentioned, one on each wing. The eyes are the same cyan color throughout, having no real iris or pupil. I hope that's clear enough to understand.
Thanks for reading, I know it was a lot. But I have a habit of explaining too thoroughly, so forgive me.
(Also, yes. Metatron, the Voice of God, in my AU appears as a bird-like being, like the Speaker of God in Hazbin Hotel. Except… more like a powerful peacock angel. I'll have to draw them sometime.)
